note: FFT weapon colours authored in the Weapon Colour Bench. rgb is already quantised to BGR555, which is what battle_wep_spr can store. Index 0 is transparent and never written. semiTransparent marks entries whose vanilla colour has bit 15 set: keep that bit or the specular renders wrong. paintedIndices lists the entries this weapon own drawing actually uses; the others are carried for completeness and only ever show on another weapon sharing the palette.
readMe: Treat entries with reviewed:true as the specification. Anything with reviewed:false is a draft or an untouched suggestion and should not be painted against.
